1.say: I sent the wrong date to the whole committee. What did you write to them? 'I was wrong about the date. The meeting is on the twelfth. I have told the office.' No explanation at all? An explanation in the first line is a defence, and a defence tells the reader the apology is not finished. When do you explain? Afterwards, if anybody asks. Never before the admission. The district asked me to write their part of the report for them. And you do not want to. I want to say no without making an enemy. Then refuse the request and keep the person. 'I am not able to write this one. I will read your draft the same day you send it.' You gave them something. I gave them something real that costs me an hour. A refusal with nothing in it reads like a door closing.

grammar.label: apology, admission and the sentence that accepts blame
grammar.form: I was wrong; we failed to; I should have; mistakes were made
grammar.meaning: accepts or evades responsibility, visibly, in the grammar

explanation.en: 'Mistakes were made' has no subject; 'I was wrong' has one. Every gradation between them is available, and readers are extremely good at spotting which one has been chosen. An apology that names the person, the act and the harm is rare enough to be disarming.
explanation.uz: 'Mistakes were made' — egasiz; 'I was wrong' — egali. Oradagi har bir darajani tanlash mumkin va o'quvchilar qaysi biri tanlanganini juda yaxshi sezadi.

grammar.positive_example: I was wrong about the date, the delay was mine, and I am sorry for it.
grammar.negative_example: Mistakes were made regarding the date and lessons have been learned.

l1_notes.uz: Uzr so'rash shakllari madaniyatga juda bog'liq; ingliz tilida egani nomlash markaziy ahamiyatga ega.

grammar.label: refusal without insult
grammar.form: the reason before the refusal; the alternative offered; the door left open
grammar.meaning: declines something while preserving the relationship

explanation.en: English refusals put the reason first and the 'no' second, because a 'no' that arrives before its reason is heard as final and personal. Offering an alternative is not softening; it is evidence that the request was taken seriously. What cannot be done is refuse and then claim it was not a refusal.
explanation.uz: Ingliz tilida rad javobi avval sabab, keyin 'yo'q' shaklida beriladi: sababsiz kelgan 'yo'q' yakuniy va shaxsiy eshitiladi.

grammar.positive_example: The budget is committed until April, so I cannot fund it this year. In April I can.
grammar.negative_example: Unfortunately no. The budget is committed. Perhaps ask somebody else about it.

l1_notes.uz: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri rad etish o'zbek muomalasida ham kam uchraydi, lekin ingliz tilidagi tartib boshqacha.

story.title: I was wrong about the date

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: I sent the wrong date to the whole committee.

body.speaker: Dilnoza
body.text: What did you write to them?

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: 'I was wrong about the date. The meeting is on the twelfth. I have told the office.'

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: An explanation in the first line is a defence, and a defence tells the reader the apology is not finished.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Afterwards, if anybody asks. Never before the admission.

body.speaker: Dilnoza
body.text: The district asked me to write their part of the report for them.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: And you do not want to.

body.speaker: Dilnoza
body.text: I want to say no without making an enemy.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Then refuse the request and keep the person. 'I am not able to write this one. I will read your draft the same day you send it.'

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: I gave them something real that costs me an hour. A refusal with nothing in it reads like a door closing.
